sentences.text: `` Rehab '' is a song written and performed by English singer and songwriter Amy Winehouse , from her second and final studio album Back to Black -LRB- 2006 -RRB- .	Amy Winehouse	Amy Winehouse	Back to Black	Back to Black	studio album	studio album

Produced by Mark Ronson , the lyrics are autobiographical and address Winehouse 's refusal one time to enter a rehabilitation clinic .	Mark Ronson	Mark Ronson	rehabilitation clinic	Drug rehabilitation

`` Rehab '' was released as the lead single from Back to Black on 23 October 2006 , and it peaked at number 7 in the United Kingdom on its Singles Chart and number 9 in the United States on the Billboard Hot 100 , becoming Winehouse 's only top 10 hit in the US .	Back to Black	Back to Black	lead single	lead single	United Kingdom	United Kingdom	Singles Chart	UK Singles Chart	United States	United States
`` Rehab '' has become a critical and commercial success internationally , and has been referred to as Winehouse 's `` signature song '' .	signature song	signature song

It won three Grammy Awards at the 50th ceremony , including Record of the Year , Song of the Year , and Best Female Pop Vocal Performance .	50th ceremony	50th Annual Grammy Awards	Record of the Year	Grammy Award for Record of the Year	Song of the Year	Grammy Award for Song of the Year	Best Female Pop Vocal Performance	Grammy Award for Best Female Pop Vocal Performance
It also won an Ivor Novello Award for Best Contemporary Song .	Ivor Novello Award	Ivor Novello Awards

Winehouse 's public battle with drug and alcohol addiction , and subsequent death , have contributed to the song 's continuing popularity and appearance in the media .	drug	Substance dependence	alcohol addiction	alcohol addiction
